# seen-scout: what the harness already says about the next action

Could not answer: the exit-code dispatch itself (where `HarnessError` and `GuardRefusal` map to
concrete codes) and `guard.decide()`'s reason text were not seen in the source it read.

`NEXT_COMMAND`, `harness/cli.py:63-73`: a dict from stage (`clarify`, `solution`, `tdd`, `review`,
`deliver`, `delivered`) to one prose sentence, for example `harness draft <ticket>, fill in the scope
and the acceptance checks, then harness advance`. It names commands inside prose, with no ticket
substituted and no argument list. Read by `start()` (cli.py:333), `build_pack()` (cli.py:336-341)
and `brief()` (cli.py:431).

`status --brief`, `brief()` at `harness/cli.py:406-431`: returns `ticket`, `stage`, `attempt`,
`records`, `pack` (the markdown), `estimated_tokens`, `pack_file`, `recorded_at`,
`pack_matches_record` and `next_command`, the same prose. The pack itself is `handoff.pack()`
(`harness/handoff.py:234-284`): title, stage and attempt, branch, record count, ticket file, then
the slice in front of you (position of total, points, name, its RED at line 264, its files, a route
line from `_route_line`), then the next command as that prose string, then capped sections for the
criteria, the decisions and the graph answers.

`harness route`: `route_slices()` (cli.py:706-714) appends via `routing.append`, state from
`routing.state()` (routing.py:209-233): stage, attempt, a `slices` entry per slice carrying model,
effort, source, rule, reason, probabilities and threshold (`_from_answers`, routing.py:235-269),
the solution mode and approach, the risk outcome, a change-risk excerpt, the graph answers and the
marketplaces. The spawn text is `implementer_task()` (routing.py:272-306), free prose: `Work slice
{position} of {ticket}: {name}.`, `Run it on {model} at {effort} effort, because {how}`, the files,
the RED text and a literal `harness check ... --phase red` line at 302-303.

`harness review triage`: the task text is `reviewer_task()` (`harness/triage.py:678-728`), carrying
the depth, the triage sequence, the model, the always-read files, the focus set, the settled,
partly-settled and outstanding checks, and the shape to return. The record's fields are read back by
`kpi.review_triage()` (`harness/kpi.py:401-439`): `record`, `depth`, `model_depth`, `shadow`,
`asked`, `rules`, `files`, `focus`, `excluded`, `excluded_share`, `reviewer_output_tokens`.

Refusals: `GuardRefusal(HarnessError)` at `harness/cli.py:28-37`, kept distinct so its exit code can
differ from a plain `HarnessError` (argparse already exits 2 on an unknown command). Messages do name
the stage and the record, for example `gates.py:141`, `Record {number} is not in this journal`.

Not checked: the exit codes themselves, `harness/guard.py`, and whether any refusal message already
carries a resume command.
